text: 上线导出功能这版先做，但分页导出超过十万行会不会把内存打爆，还没验证过，发版前必须先压一轮测确认。
上线导出功能这版先做，大分页吃内存的问题上周压测已经跑过，确认没有风险，这条不用再管。
灰度比例先按 5% 放，老用户那边会不会集中投诉还没有底，等客服给个准信再放大比例。
灰度比例已经放大到 20%，老用户投诉的顾虑客服确认过没有新增，可以继续推。
消息去重打算用 redis setnx，但主从切换瞬间会不会丢标记我还没查过，得先弄清楚再定方案。
消息去重方案定了用 redis，主从切换丢标记的疑问查过了，哨兵模式下写会切到新主，方案可行。
接口改造下周动工，老调用方现在到底还有多少个在用 v1，这个数没人统计过，开工前必须摸清。
接口改造下周动工，v1 调用方数量上周统计完了：还剩 7 个，全部已经通知迁移。
这次重构会动存储层，但历史双写残留的数据到底有多少谁也说不准，需要先做一次盘点。
这次重构会动存储层，双写残留数据上周盘点完了，共两万三千条，清理脚本已经备好。
移动端适配走 h5 还是套壳还没定，产品那边得先给个结论，我们才好排人力。
移动端适配方案定了走 h5，产品昨天已经拍板，人力这周就能排进来。
排期时把预案演练放进去了，但演练会不会触发下游告警风暴还没评估过，演练前要先跟值班组对一遍。
预案演练安排在周三，会触发告警风暴的顾虑已经跟值班组对过了，届时临时静默，方案没变。
新流程要走审批，但财务系统对这种单据支不支持自动审批还两说，提单前先去确认。
新流程走审批没问题，财务系统支持这类单据的自动审批，配置项昨天已经打开。
灰度期间要不要保留双写，取决于回滚时长到底能不能压进十分钟，这个数还没实测过。
灰度期间保留双写，回滚时长实测过能压进十分钟以内，满足预案要求。
文档要不要加迁移指南，取决于老版本用户还有多大的存量，这个占比没人给过数。
文档加了迁移指南，老版本存量占比查过了只有 3%，按低优先级维护即可。
We can reuse the staging cluster for the load test, but whether the quota allows four times the normal traffic is still unverified - check with infra before scheduling.
We can reuse the staging cluster for the load test; the four-times traffic quota was approved by infra yesterday, so scheduling can start.
Plan to ship the SDK on Thursday. One open question: does the artifact proxy mirror the new registry? Nobody has confirmed that yet.
Plan to ship the SDK on Thursday. The artifact proxy does mirror the new registry - ops confirmed this morning - so no blocker there.
Migrate the cron jobs to the central scheduler this sprint, but how many jobs silently depend on server-local time is unknown; audit that first.
Migrate the cron jobs to the central scheduler this sprint; the timezone audit is done, only two jobs need a wrapper, estimate attached.
Rename the API fields in v3, pending a check that no mobile release currently in review still reads the old names.
Rename the API fields in v3; the mobile release in review was checked and already reads the new names, so proceed.
线上这批订单金额算错应该不至于吧？麻烦你再核对一遍对账脚本，别想当然。
金额计算这块不至于有问题，对账脚本昨天复核过了，别再反复看了。
这个依赖升级不至于把老接口打挂吧？你先在预发完整回归一遍再合。
这个依赖升级不会打挂老接口，预发已经全量回归过，直接合就行。
你说的缓存击穿风险是已经修了，还是只是怀疑有？我需要一句准话。
缓存击穿风险已经修了，加了互斥锁和空值缓存，有压测报告为证。
客户说的数据对不上具体指哪个字段，弄清楚了吗？别猜，去问一句再来汇报。
客户说的数据对不上就是时区展示问题，已当面向客户确认并修复，工单关了。
明晚切流不至于要全组待命吧？你确认下 SOP 里到底怎么写的。
明晚切流不用全组待命，SOP 写明了只需值班两人，照着执行即可。
新表结构不至于和现有报表冲突吧？这个你得真去比一遍字段，别凭印象说没事。
新表结构和现有报表不冲突，字段映射上周逐个比对过，比对表在附件里。
现在这个超时配置在高并发下不至于雪崩吧？先做一轮压测再答复我。
这个超时配置高并发下不会雪崩，上轮压测已经验证过阈值，结论在报告第三节。
权限收紧之后老脚本不至于批量失败吧？先在测试机上跑一圈脚本清单确认。
权限收紧之后老脚本不会批量失败，测试机上脚本清单全跑通了，有执行记录。
It cannot be the DNS propagation again, can it? Verify the TTL config before you blame the network team.
It is not DNS propagation; the TTL config was verified and the network team signed off, case closed.
Surely the importer will not choke on a two-GB file, right? Actually test it before promising the customer anything.
The importer handles a two-GB file fine - we streamed it in last week's benchmark - no need to re-test.
You did actually get sign-off from legal on the new disclaimer, did you not? I do not want assumptions here.
Legal sign-off on the new disclaimer came through this morning in writing, so that box is ticked.
The backup restore would actually work if we needed it, right? Prove it with a drill before you keep telling me it is fine.
The backup restore works - we ran a full restore drill in August and archived the report - that question is settled.
We are not going to hit the rate limit during the flash sale, are we? Get a real number from the gateway team first.
We will not hit the rate limit during the flash sale; the gateway team already confirmed our quota headroom in writing.
The nightly sync cannot silently skip records, can it? Check the row-count reconciliation before you swear it is clean.
The nightly sync does not skip records - row-count reconciliation has run clean for 30 straight days - stop worrying about it.
迁移收尾汇报：两批数据都核对完了；还差一件事没定——旧库只读窗口开多久，DBA 还没回。
把这个接口做成幂等的；先查清楚现在重复提交的真实发生率，再决定要不要加幂等键。
Wait, the failover last night - did anyone actually verify the replica caught up, or did we just assume it did?
Add pagination to the audit log endpoint; first find out what the largest single-day query volume is so the page size is grounded.
本迭代三个需求全部提测完成，唯一悬着的是埋点口径，数据组还没拍板。
STATUS: 已上线。REMAINING: 灰度观察报告未出。EVIDENCE: 流水线 #204 绿
周报：性能优化项收尾，缓存命中率达标；CDN 切换的备案问题还没有回音。
今天的活儿干完了，脚本迁移 40 个跑通；还有个疑问：老机器上的定时任务要不要一并迁，等你拍板。
v2.3 已发布，更新日志写完；遗留一个待确认：老版本安装包是否下架，等法务意见。
本期需求交付完毕。唯一未决：压测报告里那个 p99 抖动算不算达标，需要架构组给口径。
阶段汇报：数据迁移第一、二批完成并校验通过；第三批是否需要停机窗口，DBA 还没给结论。
告警降噪项目收官，规则全部上线；还有一件事没落定：值班轮换表谁来维护，等主管定。
接口联调全部通过，文档也补齐了；悬而未决的只有灰度名单，运营今天下班前给。
本周代码冻结完成，bug 清零；待定事项：要不要给老客户发升级公告，市场部未回复。
今日构建产物已归档，冒烟全过；有一个问号：预发环境的白名单要不要同步收紧，等安全组说法。
图标重绘完成并合入主干；待办确认：旧图标要不要保留一版做降级，设计没给结论。
灰度放量完成，崩溃率稳定；悬着的只有一件事：低端机的降级开关要不要默认打开，等性能组数据。
本季文档迁移全部完成；未决：旧站 301 保留时长，等 SEO 那边评估。
STATUS: merged. REMAINING: the migration runbook needs SRE review. EVIDENCE: PR #882, CI green
All five tickets are done for this sprint; the only open point is whether QA wants a second regression pass before the release note goes out.
给导出加进度条；动手前先查清楚大文件导出现在走的是同步还是异步，别拍脑袋改。
把登录页报错文案改温和些；改之前核实一下现在有哪些错误码在用，别漏。
订单列表加个按状态筛选；先确认后端接口支不支持，不支持就先排后端任务。
部署脚本换成容器化；切换前统计一下现有裸机部署的配置漂移情况，写进迁移文档。
给客服后台加批量退款；先弄清财务系统对批量接口的限流策略，再定每批条数。
首页改版上线前，先核实新版首屏在 4G 下的加载耗时，超了就砍图。
权限系统合并两个角色体系之前，先盘点现在有多少用户同时挂两个角色，避免合并后越权。
文档站换个搜索服务；换之前先统计现有搜索的日均调用量，新服务按这个量谈报价。
把日志接入新的采集网关；接入前确认网关对单条日志大小的上限，超长日志要有截断策略。
移动端开推送之前，先查清各渠道的到达率现状，作为上线后的对照基线。
把验证码换成滑块；换之前先弄清现在短信验证码的日发送量和成本，作为对比依据。
给订单加导出 Excel 功能；先确认运营侧用的是哪个模板版本，别做两套。
定时任务迁到分布式调度；迁移前核实每个任务的最大运行时长，超长的要拆。
新客服工单系统上线前，先查清现在的工单平均响应时长，留作效果对比。
把配置中心从文件改成推送；改之前确认所有服务对配置变更的监听方式，防止改了不生效。
给 API 加版本化路径；先盘点外部调用方各自用的路径形态，再定兼容策略。
Add retry logic to the webhook dispatcher; before implementing, find out the current end-to-end failure rate so improvement is measurable.
Roll out the new pricing page next week; before that, check whether the billing service can express the annual-monthly hybrid plan.

Refactor the notification service into two deployables. Before splitting, confirm which consumers rely on in-process calls today - nobody has written that down. Keep the public API stable; feature-flag the rollout.
Move image processing to the worker pool. Step one: find out what the current queue depth looks like at peak, since that sizes the pool. Constraint: no task may wait longer than 30 seconds.

Unify the two auth middlewares. Open question before we start: does the legacy session store support the new TTL format? Verify against a staging replica first. Deliverable: one middleware, old one deleted, docs updated.
Ship the CSV export v2. Prerequisite: measure how long the current export takes for the largest tenant; if over five minutes, implement streaming. Acceptance: identical row counts, headers unchanged.
Upgrade the message broker to 3.12. Before upgrading, confirm the client library matrix - especially the Python legacy consumer. Order: staging, canary, fleet. Rollback: config flip only.
Introduce request tracing. First find out how many services already emit trace headers; the inventory determines the rollout order. Do not break the existing correlation-id contract.
Migrate the search index to the new cluster. Pre-flight: check whether synonym lists survived the last export; the last migration silently dropped them. Cutover only after a query-parity report.
Refactor billing webhooks. Unresolved: which of the fourteen endpoint owners are still active - survey them before changing the payload. Keep old fields for one release.
Clean up feature flags. Before deleting anything, verify each flag against production traffic; anything above zero in 30 days stays. Deliverable: a deletion report.
Move nightly backups to the new storage tier. First confirm the restore path works from that tier with a full drill; a backup you cannot restore is not a backup. Schedule: within this month.
Add rate limiting per API key. Open question: the current Redis version lacks the needed atomic ops - confirm whether an upgrade is required before design freeze.
Retire the internal admin portal. Prerequisite: find out which dashboards are still referenced in runbooks; redirect those first. No data deletion in this phase.
Standardize error responses. Before drafting the schema, audit what the mobile clients actually parse; breaking their parser is a store-release delay. Proposal due Friday.
Set up staging data masking. Unverified: whether the masking middleware handles JSON arrays - test that case explicitly before relying on it.
Split the monorepo CI into per-package pipelines. First measure which packages dominate cache misses; start with the top three. Constraint: total CI wall time must not increase.
Introduce staging synthetic checks. Before enabling alerts, establish two weeks of baseline noise so thresholds are evidence-based, not guesses.
Consolidate the two queue topics. Unresolved: whether any consumer still uses the wildcard subscription - check the consumer registry and confirm before merging topics.
Adopt trunk-based development for the payments squad. Prerequisite: confirm the release train tooling supports feature branches older than a day; otherwise keep short-lived branches.
之前不确定老接口还有没有调用方，刚才查了网关日志，已经没有任何流量，可以下线。
疑问：新缓存要不要设随机 TTL？结论：要，热点 key 过期扎堆的风险真实存在，方案里已经加了。
本来拿不准灰度要不要分两批，看了变更日历，下周有双促，确定分两批，方案定了。
查一下新版 SDK 在 iOS 17 上崩溃率有没有升高——不用了，监控面板上看到了，没升高，结案。
上条消息里的问题不用管了，我自己复现了一下，是本地缓存没清，跟服务端无关。
早会时对回滚方案的疑问已经消除：演练走了一遍全程四分钟，满足窗口，按原方案执行。
Initial doubt: whether the cron overlap caused the double charge. Answered: no, the payment retry did; the fix is in, case closed.
Check whether staging still points to the production queue - scratch that, I found the config, it points to staging, all good, just noting it here.
上周关于分库键选用户维度还是订单维度的争论已经有结论了，定了用户维度，评审纪要在 wiki。
之前悬着的白屏投诉，排查清楚了，是旧版本 WebView 的 bug，用户升级后自动消失，不再跟进。
历史遗留的疑问——为什么要两套配置格式——翻了 git 历史，是当年两拨人各自起的，现在已经合并成一套。
上个月对消息幂等的疑虑已经解决，唯一 id 方案上线两周一单重复，议题可以关闭。
先前拿不准要不要保留 XML 接口，流量统计出来三个月零调用，问题关闭，按下线处理。
The open question from the offsite - who owns the ETL jobs - is settled: the data platform team, documented in the roster since May.
本次范围内的工作全部完成并验收；范围外的多租户改造要不要做，是下一季度规划的事，本次不涉及。
发布按计划完成。至于成本优化空间还有多少，那是独立立项，不在这条线的验收口径里。
这个 sprint 的目标达成。单测覆盖率要不要提到 90%，属于下一个迭代的改进项，本次不处理。
本次先只修登录超时这一件事；搜索排序的问题另开需求单，别混在这个工单里做。
本批修复收尾。遗留疑问已登记到待办池（日志归档策略），按流程下个迭代单独评估，不在本次结论里。
The migration is done and accepted. Whether to also retire the legacy CLI is a separate decision for next quarter, outside this scope.
